          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255

          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison

            E.164 form; spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped, a leading '+' and country
            code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form; spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped, a leading '+' and country
            code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The stored value is a '+'
            followed by 8 to 15 digits and is returned in that form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:

## Summary

The change assigns each new owner a `customerCode` formatted `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` at creation time, and exposes it on the owner read model.

**Domain model** (`Owner.java`)
- Added a persisted `customerCode` field mapped to a new `customer_code` column, with getter/setter, and included it in `toString()`.

**Schema** — added the `customer_code` column to all four DB schemas (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) so every profile stays consistent (tests run on hsqldb).

**API contract** (`openapi.yml`) — added `customerCode` as a `readOnly` property on the `Owner` schema, alongside the existing derived `displayName`/`initials`. The generated `OwnerDto` picks it up and MapStruct maps it by name automatically, so it's returned by `GET /api/owners/{id}`.

**Counting owners** — added a `count()` method to the `OwnerRepository` interface with implementations in all three persistence layers (JPA, JDBC, and an explicit `@Query` on the Spring Data repo), surfaced through the service facade as `ClinicService.countOwners()`.

**Code generation** — a new single-responsibility `CustomerCodeGenerator` component builds the code: upper-cased first three letters of the last name, a hyphen, and `count + 1` zero-padded to 4 digits (`String.format("%s-%04d", ...)`).

**Wiring** (`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`) — after the existing validation/normalization/registration-date defaulting, it assigns `owner.setCustomerCode(generator.generate(lastName, clinicService.countOwners()))` before saving. Because the count is taken before each save, the second owner created sees a count one higher, giving the global sequence the spec requires.

The acceptance test (`SMI-`/`JON-` prefixes and consecutive global sequence) and the full suite pass.
